issues.what: In the supplied samples, the bright curved limb sweeps toward the upper right, then gives way to a horizon sloping down to the right. The storm loses definition in the beige blur and reappears under a darker cloud deck, so the handoff reads more like a change of camera orientation and exposure than a continuous dive.
issues.fix: Match the projected limb and storm track on both sides of the cover, ease the camera roll through it, and carry exposure and atmospheric falloff across the handoff.

issues.where: end of the supplied pack at frame 3059
issues.what: The pack shows the hold, dive and first terrain views, but no dedicated terrain or rise sheet and no consecutive-frame cover sheet. The sampled frames cannot establish terrain parallax, the return flight, or frame-level continuity across the cover.
issues.fix: Supply review-tier terrain and rise contact sheets and consecutive frames across every cover, including the globe-to-terrain handoff.

issues.where: frames 2901–2969, moon and the dark shape immediately to its right
issues.what: The dark shape lengthens while staying visually attached to the moon, making the two read as a moon with a trailing smear rather than a moon moving in front of a separate cloud deck.
issues.fix: Make the projected shadow read on the cloud deck: separate its screen-space contact with the moon where the geometry allows, and soften its edge where it stretches across the clouds.
